title: Refresh BOM AST hashes and harden CI artifact path policy
intent: Unblock the pytest PR gate by refreshing stale BOM script AST hashes, make BOM refresh keys cross-platform, and harden CI --out containment so relative outs resolve from the caller cwd artifacts/ while debt absolute outs stay limited to the system temp directory.

scope.out_of_scope_notes: No analyzer finding logic or schema contracts changed. Debt snapshot intentionally allows absolute CI outs under tempfile.gettempdir(); scan/--out does not.

what_changed: Refreshed BOM manifest AST hashes for the two drifted release BOM scripts on Python 3.11 and switched refresh_bom_manifest.py keys to as_posix().
Shared CI relative --out resolution through one helper anchored to Path.cwd()/artifacts/ for both debt snapshot and scan.
Kept debt-only absolute CI outs, restricted to the system temp directory, and documented that scan rejects absolute outs.
Added regression coverage for relative escape, path traversal, caller-cwd placement, and scan absolute rejection.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Stale BOM hashes block every PR gate, and without cwd-anchored relative outs CI subprocess tests write into the scanned fixture tree. The shared relative helper plus temp-only absolute debt exception closes the mid-PR arbitrary absolute-write hole without breaking deterministic tmp_path snapshot tests.

verification.notes: CI policy: relative outs must stay under the caller's ./artifacts/; debt absolute outs may use system temp only; scan absolute outs remain rejected.
